notes: ROS 2 package mavros 2.1.1 (galactic). Topic names are private (~/) names on per-plugin sub-nodes created as rclcpp::Node(subnode, <UAS FQN>); resolved names assume the default mavros_node container, where the UAS node is named "mavros" in the root namespace; a different node name/namespace at launch would change the prefix. Frames are parameter-backed: global fix header uses parameter child_frame_id (default "base_link", also set in launch/px4_config.yaml and apm_config.yaml); local pose header uses parameter frame_id (default "map"). Local pose units left null: code converts MAVLink LOCAL_POSITION_NED NED->ENU (ftf::transform_frame_ned_enu, comment cites REP-105 for ENU) without scaling, but neither code nor PoseStamped/Pose definitions state a unit. QoS values come from rclcpp::SensorDataQoS() set in code; the profile contents are cited from the rclcpp/rmw galactic sources from knowledge (only .msg files were fetched); deadline is RMW_QOS_DEADLINE_DEFAULT (unset), recorded null. No publish rate is set; both topics are published per received MAVLink message (GLOBAL_POSITION_INT; LOCAL_POSITION_NED, or LOCAL_POSITION_NED_COV when LOCAL_POSITION_NED is absent). msg_type written as pkg/Type (rosidl names sensor_msgs/msg/NavSatFix, geometry_msgs/msg/PoseStamped). definition_id is the sha256_normalised proxy of the top-level .msg only. Dependency .msg files were fetched to a temporary directory outside the workspace solely to hash them. Side observation outside the packet elements: python client mavros/mavros/local_position.py:81 subscribes Odometry on local_position/local while the C++ plugin publishes ~/odom.
